name: baton
line: the accountability layer for agent runs
question: What if every agent run kept a record — evidence that cites, verdicts per criterion, and gates a person holds?
body: A router prompt that turns a fresh session into a multi-agent run with a record: evidence that cites or retracts, verdicts computed per criterion, gates a person holds, and state that outlives the laptop. Three tiers replace six rungs — cheap for what a command can settle, frontier for everything with judgment, a person when frontier has failed twice. One more line, TEAM: github, hands the same run to a team.
alt: baton v5 — work routed to three tiers (cheap, frontier, a person) while every step lands in a record of evidence, verdicts and gates
